script.speaker: Lecturer
script.textEn: Good afternoon, everyone. Today's lecture is about the science of sleep.

script.speaker: Lecturer
script.textEn: Most adults need between seven and nine hours of sleep per night.

script.speaker: Lecturer
script.textEn: Sleep is divided into two main types: REM sleep and non-REM sleep.

script.speaker: Lecturer
script.textEn: During REM sleep, our brains are highly active and we experience vivid dreams.

script.speaker: Lecturer
script.textEn: Non-REM sleep has three stages, and the deepest stage is essential for physical recovery.

script.speaker: Lecturer
script.textEn: Research shows that lack of sleep affects memory consolidation significantly.

script.speaker: Lecturer
script.textEn: Students who sleep less than six hours often perform worse in exams.

script.speaker: Lecturer
script.textEn: Interestingly, the hormone melatonin regulates our sleep-wake cycle.

script.speaker: Lecturer
script.textEn: Melatonin levels rise in the evening when it gets dark.

script.speaker: Lecturer
script.textEn: Exposure to blue light from screens can suppress melatonin production.

script.speaker: Lecturer
script.textEn: This is why experts recommend avoiding phones at least one hour before bed.

script.speaker: Lecturer
script.textEn: In conclusion, good sleep is as important as diet and exercise for our health.

script.speaker: Lecturer
script.textEn: Next week, we'll discuss the effects of caffeine on sleep quality.

title: Lecture: The Science of Sleep
titleVi: Bài giảng: Khoa học về giấc ngủ

script.speaker: Librarian
script.textEn: Welcome to the Central Library orientation. I'm Ms. Thompson, the head librarian.

script.speaker: Librarian
script.textEn: The library is open from 8 am to 10 pm on weekdays, and from 9 am to 6 pm on weekends.

script.speaker: Librarian
script.textEn: You can borrow up to six books at a time for a period of three weeks.

script.speaker: Librarian
script.textEn: If you need a book for longer, you can renew it online twice.

script.speaker: Librarian
script.textEn: Please note that reference books and journals cannot be taken out of the library.

script.speaker: Librarian
script.textEn: The quiet study area on the third floor is available for individual work only.

script.speaker: Librarian
script.textEn: Group discussions should take place in the seminar rooms on the ground floor.

script.speaker: Librarian
script.textEn: Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the building; the password is posted at the front desk.

script.speaker: Librarian
script.textEn: Printing costs 10 cents per page for black and white, and 50 cents for colour.

script.speaker: Librarian
script.textEn: If you lose your library card, please report it immediately to avoid fines.

script.speaker: Librarian
script.textEn: A replacement card costs five dollars and takes two days to process.

script.speaker: Librarian
script.textEn: Are there any questions? If not, let's begin the tour of the facilities.

script.speaker: Guide
script.textEn: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to the Natural History Museum.

script.speaker: Guide
script.textEn: Our museum houses over 80 million specimens collected from around the world.

script.speaker: Guide
script.textEn: We'll begin our tour in the Dinosaur Gallery on the first floor.

script.speaker: Guide
script.textEn: The centrepiece is the skeleton of a 25-metre-long Diplodocus.

script.speaker: Guide
script.textEn: This particular skeleton was discovered in Wyoming in 1898.

script.speaker: Guide
script.textEn: After that, we'll visit the Ocean Life exhibition, which opened just last year.

script.speaker: Guide
script.textEn: There you can see a life-size model of a blue whale suspended from the ceiling.

script.speaker: Guide
script.textEn: Please remember that photography without flash is permitted in all galleries.

script.speaker: Guide
script.textEn: The museum café on the ground floor serves lunch from 11:30 until 2:30.

script.speaker: Guide
script.textEn: Our gift shop offers a 10% discount to all tour members today.

script.speaker: Guide
script.textEn: The tour will last approximately 90 minutes and end at the main entrance.

script.speaker: Guide
script.textEn: Please stay with the group, and feel free to ask questions at any time.

title: Guided Tour: Natural History Museum
